headline: Monitor an aerosmart ventilation and heat-pump system
intro: The aerosmart integration connects locally to the ventilation and heat-pump controllers over Modbus TCP or serial Modbus RTU. It represents the combined installation as one Home Assistant device and provides sensors for operating values, filter information, and controller status.
highlights: Connect through a Modbus TCP gateway or a serial Modbus RTU port; the integration does not use a cloud service
Configure the ventilation and heat-pump unit addresses, which default to 1 and 2 respectively
Monitor temperatures, fan speeds, airflow, filter counters, heat-pump status, and controller information with sensor entities

flow.title: Connect both aerosmart controllers
stages: Choose a reachable Modbus TCP gateway or a serial Modbus RTU connection
Set the connection details and the ventilation and heat-pump unit addresses
Review sensor readings from the combined aerosmart installation
